discriminating_checks: The actual rank IR preserves the explicit output and a later Filter barrier. Missing, duplicate, unknown, cross-block and unseparated yield are refused.

GQT executes three lexical sources over one incoming population. Reordering declarations or adding a nonmatching unused source preserves output. Choosing another output changes membership according to its independent window.

Missing source membership produces null rank/score values. JSON omits null-valued keys under the existing writer; GQT shape checks require every projected column and its Arrow type, including an all-null F64 column.
The inherited-order GQT owner first failed because it required a final order clause. Rank now supplies an admitted total ordering path; a take-only control remains refused.
Column demand, graph-read descriptors, GQT construct detection and GQT traversal detection walk later stages.
The graph-tail owner refuses 100200 bindings despite final limit 1, preserves the accepted graph version, and proves a later plain query still works.

Invalid later query text, candidate windows, edit budgets and group quotas fail before an oversized corpus field is scanned. This includes unused sources. Valid-input controls reach that field refusal.
